name: Kyouko no Ijiwaru!! ~Hachamecha Daishingeki~
original_name: 恭子のいぢわる!! ～ハチャメチャ大進撃～
source:
Heroine Tokugawa Koyko owns Tokushima Takabee group and trillions of yen. One day she misinterpreted her brother's flu symptoms for an incurable disease and went to search for the medicine component of virgin's grey tiny hair in St. Rodrigues Academy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角德川恭子拥有德岛高飞集团和数万亿日元资产。一天，她误把弟弟的流感症状当成绝症，于是前往圣罗德里格斯学院，寻找一种药物原料——处女的灰色阴毛。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
